changeSet.author: Core
changeSet.sql:
IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = 'dbo' AND TABLE_NAME = 'Predicate') BEGIN CREATE TABLE [dbo].[Predicate]( [ID] [int] IDENTITY(1,1) NOT NULL, [Name] [nvarchar](100) NOT NULL, [Inverse] [nvarchar](250) NULL, [Type] [int] NOT NULL, [IsSystem] [bit] CONSTRAINT [DF_Predicate_IsSystem] DEFAULT (0) NOT NULL, [UID] [uniqueidentifier] CONSTRAINT [DF_Predicate_UID] DEFAULT (newid()) NOT NULL, CONSTRAINT [PK_Predicate] PRIMARY KEY CLUSTERED ( [ID] ASC ) ) END
IF NOT EXISTS (select * from sys.indexes where name = 'IX_Predicate_Name') BEGIN CREATE NONCLUSTERED INDEX [IX_Predicate_Name] ON [dbo].[Predicate] ( [Name] ASC ) END
IF NOT EXISTS (select * from sys.indexes where name = 'IX_Predicate_Phrase') BEGIN CREATE NONCLUSTERED INDEX [IX_Predicate_Phrase] ON [dbo].[Predicate] ( [Inverse] ASC ) END
IF NOT EXISTS (select * from sys.indexes where name = 'IX_Predicate_Type') BEGIN CREATE NONCLUSTERED INDEX [IX_Predicate_Type] ON [dbo].[Predicate] ( [Type] ASC ) END

changeSet.author: sdooley
changeSet.sql:
if exists (select * from [INFORMATION_SCHEMA].[COLUMNS] where TABLE_SCHEMA = 'dbo' and TABLE_NAME = 'Predicate' and COLUMN_NAME = 'Code') begin if exists (select sdc.name from sys.default_constraints sdc where object_name(sdc.parent_object_id) = 'Predicate' and sdc.name = 'DF_Predicate_Code' ) begin alter table [dbo].[Predicate] DROP CONSTRAINT DF_Predicate_Code; end
alter table [dbo].[Predicate] drop column [Code] end
changeSet.rollback:
if not exists (select * from [INFORMATION_SCHEMA].[COLUMNS] where TABLE_SCHEMA = 'dbo' and TABLE_NAME = 'Predicate' and COLUMN_NAME = 'Code') begin alter table [dbo].[Predicate] add [Code] [varchar](25)
ALTER TABLE [dbo].[Predicate] ADD CONSTRAINT [DF_Predicate_Code] DEFAULT ((0)) FOR [Code] end

changeSet.author: sdooley
changeSet.rollback: CREATE OR ALTER TRIGGER [dbo].[Predicate_AfterInsert] ON [dbo].[Predicate] AFTER INSERT AS BEGIN SET NOCOUNT ON; update T set T.Code = cast(S.ID as varchar(25)) from [Predicate] T inner join inserted S on S.ID = T.ID and S.[Code] = '0' END

changeSet.author: sDooley
changeSet.sql:
CREATE OR ALTER TRIGGER [dbo].[Predicate_AfterInsert] ON [dbo].[Predicate] FOR INSERT AS BEGIN SET NOCOUNT ON;
INSERT INTO [queue].[Task] ([Action], [Custom], [Object], [ObjectID]) select 'Add', [queue].WriteIndexXml('', 'Predicate', ID, 0), 'Predicate', ID from inserted END

CREATE OR ALTER TRIGGER [dbo].[Predicate_AfterDelete] ON [dbo].[Predicate] AFTER DELETE AS BEGIN SET NOCOUNT ON;
INSERT INTO [queue].[Task] ([Action], [Custom], [Object], [ObjectID]) select 'Delete', [queue].WriteIndexXml('Removed', 'Predicate', ID, 0), 'Predicate', ID from deleted END
